external_games.name: Angel's Games Chapter 1: Go to School

name: Angel's Games Chapter 1: Go to School
summary:
Angel's Games “Go to School” is the first chapter in a series of five interactive visual novels. Accompany Angel on his way to school and help him complete his day without difficulty!

But be careful… his survival depends entirely on you.

Discover the first fragments of the macabre story hidden behind this endearing character, and the tragic fate of a universe abandoned by its own creators.

Don’t forget, once you launch this game, you will no longer be alone… Something… or someone is watching you
